packet.research_question: What interactional processes move these fictional buyer-seller disputes toward repair or impasse?
packet.context_note: The packet contains four fictional human-to-human buyer-seller dialogues. Analyze turns in sequence and avoid inferring national or cultural traits.

excerpts.text: The blue kettle arrived, but the listing and my order both say red. I would like a replacement or a refund.
Please send a photograph of the label so I can compare it with the packing record. If we shipped the wrong color, I will cover the return.
I sent the photograph. A prepaid return and the red kettle would resolve this for me.
The parcel is twelve days late. Your message saying be patient sounded like you were dismissing the problem.
I am sorry my short wording sounded dismissive. Tracking shows a customs hold; I can open an inquiry today or refund if there is no scan in three days.
Thank you for explaining the wording and giving a date. I can wait three more days if you send the inquiry number.
Your first message was very direct, and I read it as an accusation. I now see that you were listing the missing parts.
I meant the numbered list to be clear, not hostile. I can resend it with photographs and would accept the missing parts instead of a full refund.
That works. I will confirm each part against the photographs before shipping them.
I will accept only a full refund today. I will not provide another video because I already sent one last week.
Our policy requires a new video with the serial number visible. I will not discuss a refund without it.
Then we are repeating the same demand. I am ending this conversation and using the platform appeal.

output.research_question: What interactional processes move these fictional buyer-seller disputes toward repair or impasse?
output.analysis_summary: Repair follows evidence requests, acknowledgment, clarification, and time-bounded options; impasse follows incompatible demands and refusal to provide required evidence.

codes.label: Evidence request
codes.definition: A participant requests or supplies documentation to establish facts.
codes.inclusion_rule: Include photographs, videos, tracking, or records.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude unsupported assertion.

exemplars.quote: Please send a photograph of the label

codes.label: Repair proposal
codes.definition: A participant offers a concrete remedy or acceptable resolution.
codes.inclusion_rule: Include refund, replacement, parts, inquiry, or return proposal.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude vague willingness.

exemplars.quote: A prepaid return and the red kettle would resolve this for me.

codes.label: Acknowledgment and reframe
codes.definition: A turn recognizes impact or revises an interpretation.
codes.inclusion_rule: Include apology, explanation, or changed reading.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude repetition of a demand.

exemplars.quote: I am sorry my short wording sounded dismissive.

codes.label: Conditional commitment
codes.definition: A party accepts or offers next steps tied to a date or condition.
codes.inclusion_rule: Include explicit deadline, inquiry number, or condition.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude unconditional complaint.

exemplars.quote: I can wait three more days

codes.label: Demand impasse
codes.definition: Participants maintain incompatible demands and end or block the exchange.
codes.inclusion_rule: Include refusal, repeated demand, or appeal escalation.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude negotiated conditions.

exemplars.quote: I am ending this conversation

assignments.rationale: Buyer requests replacement or refund.
Seller requests label evidence and offers return coverage.
Buyer reports sent photograph and proposes remedy.
Buyer reports perceived dismissal, beginning repair-relevant dispute.
Seller acknowledges wording and gives conditional options.
Buyer accepts a date contingent on inquiry number.
Seller revises accusation interpretation.
Buyer clarifies intent and offers parts remedy.
Seller commits to checking photographs before shipping.
Buyer sets an exclusive demand and refuses new video.
Seller conditions refund on evidence and refuses discussion.
Buyer ends exchange and escalates appeal.

themes.name: Repair through clarification
themes.claim: Disputes move toward repair when parties clarify intent or impact and pair that clarification with evidence and a feasible next step.
themes.explanation: The interaction changes after acknowledgment, not merely after repeating positions.

evidence.quote: Tracking shows a customs hold; I can open an inquiry today
evidence.warrant: Explanation and action follow acknowledgment.

evidence.quote: I meant the numbered list to be clear, not hostile.
evidence.warrant: Intent is clarified before compromise.

counterevidence.quote: I will not discuss a refund without it.
counterevidence.warrant: Conditionality becomes a block when demands remain incompatible.

boundary_conditions: Sequence is limited to four fictional dialogues.

themes.name: Impasse through fixed conditions
themes.claim: Impasse emerges when each party treats its condition as non-negotiable and the exchange loses a shared next step.
themes.explanation: The final dialogue explicitly repeats incompatible evidence and refund demands.

evidence.quote: I will accept only a full refund today.
evidence.warrant: Buyer narrows remedy and timing.

evidence.quote: Then we are repeating the same demand.
evidence.warrant: Buyer marks interactional repetition.

counterevidence.quote: I can wait three more days
counterevidence.warrant: A different dialogue accepts a bounded condition.

boundary_conditions: This describes turn sequences, not stable buyer or seller traits.

negative_cases.quote: I can wait three more days
negative_cases.implication: Negotiated waiting is a repair case.

uncertainties: Outcomes after the dialogues are unknown.
alternative_interpretations: Evidence requirements may be procedural safeguards rather than interpersonal refusal.
limitations: Only three turns per dialogue are supplied.

output.research_question: What interactional processes move these fictional buyer-seller disputes toward repair or impasse?
output.analysis_summary: Across the dialogues, repair is pursued through specifying the problem, checking evidence, recognizing impact or intent, and offering a bounded next step. The fourth dialogue instead ends after incompatible demands and a policy condition are repeated.

codes.label: Specific problem statement
codes.definition: A speaker states the discrepancy, delay, or missing item and a desired outcome.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply to concrete issue descriptions or resolution requests.
codes.exclusion_rule: Do not apply to a general expression of frustration without a named issue.

exemplars.quote: I would like a replacement or a refund.

codes.label: Evidence-oriented verification
codes.definition: A speaker requests or offers photographs, labels, records, or confirmation to check the dispute.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply to explicit evidentiary checking.
codes.exclusion_rule: Do not apply to a remedy that needs no verification.

codes.label: Impact or intent clarification
codes.definition: A speaker clarifies how wording was received or what an earlier action meant.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply to explicit recognition or explanation of interactional meaning.
codes.exclusion_rule: Do not infer apology or hostility from direct wording alone.

exemplars.quote: I am sorry my short wording sounded dismissive.

codes.label: Bounded remedy or next step
codes.definition: A participant offers or accepts a concrete remedy, inquiry, time frame, or conditional action.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply to actionable, stated next steps.
codes.exclusion_rule: Do not apply to a demand with no proposed route forward.

exemplars.quote: I can wait three more days if you send the inquiry number.

codes.label: Rigid condition
codes.definition: A speaker makes a non-negotiable demand or policy requirement that blocks the offered alternative.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply to explicit only, will not, or requires language in the impasse sequence.
codes.exclusion_rule: Do not apply to a conditional remedy that permits multiple options.

exemplars.quote: I will not discuss a refund without it.

codes.label: Escalation out of dialogue
codes.definition: A speaker ends the exchange and moves the dispute to another forum.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply to explicit ending or platform appeal.
codes.exclusion_rule: Do not apply to agreement on a next step.

exemplars.quote: I am ending this conversation and using the platform appeal.

assignments.rationale: The buyer names a color discrepancy and desired remedies.
The seller requests a photograph and conditionally offers to cover return.
The buyer reports sending evidence and specifies a workable remedy.
The buyer names delay and the dismissive impact of wording.
The seller recognizes impact, explains tracking, and offers options with a date.

The seller states a required new video and refuses refund discussion without it.

themes.name: Repair develops through clarification plus a concrete route
themes.claim: In the first three dialogues, repair moves forward when speakers clarify the dispute or interactional meaning and couple that clarification with a specific next step.
themes.explanation: Sequence matters: evidence or reinterpretation is followed by a feasible return, inquiry, replacement, or shipment action.

themes.name: Repeated non-negotiable positions lead to impasse
themes.claim: In the fourth dialogue, the exchange reaches impasse when a full-refund demand and a new-video requirement remain incompatible and are repeated.
themes.explanation: The buyer's refusal and seller's policy condition are followed by an explicit statement that the same demand is repeating and a platform appeal.

counterevidence.quote: I can wait three more days

uncertainties: The dialogues end before material outcomes are confirmed.
alternative_interpretations: The fourth dialogue may reflect a documentation dispute rather than a permanently failed relationship.

output.research_question: What interactional processes move these fictional buyer-seller disputes toward repair or impasse?
output.analysis_summary: Three dialogues move toward repair through specific problem descriptions, evidence requests or provision, acknowledgment of perceived tone, and bounded options with timelines. The fourth reaches impasse when incompatible demands over renewed proof and an immediate refund are repeated, prompting exit to platform appeal.

codes.label: Specific problem and remedy
codes.definition: A turn identifies the disputed condition and states an acceptable remedy.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply when both the problem or disputed demand and a requested resolution are explicit.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude turns that only acknowledge or implement an already agreed step.

codes.label: Evidence coordination
codes.definition: A speaker requests, supplies, or commits to checking evidence relevant to the dispute.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply to photographs, videos, records, tracking, or inquiry identifiers used to assess or document the claim.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude unsupported assertions and policy demands with no evidence object.

exemplars.quote: send a photograph of the label so I can compare it with the packing record

codes.label: Metacommunicative repair
codes.definition: A turn names and revises an interpretation of prior wording, directness, or tone.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply when speakers explicitly discuss how an earlier message sounded or was intended.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude apologies or thanks that do not address interpretation of communication.

exemplars.quote: I am sorry my short wording sounded dismissive.

codes.label: Bounded option or timeline
codes.definition: A turn offers or accepts a conditional option, alternative remedy, or concrete deadline.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply when next steps are limited by a stated condition, time, or acceptable alternative.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude unconditional refusal or vague future action.

exemplars.quote: I can wait three more days if you send the inquiry number.

codes.label: Reciprocal uptake
codes.definition: A speaker accepts, accommodates, or operationalizes the other party's proposed next step.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply when a turn shows alignment that advances the sequence toward resolution.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude unilateral proposals not yet taken up.

exemplars.quote: That works. I will confirm each part against the photographs before shipping them.

codes.label: Incompatible demand and exit
codes.definition: Speakers maintain conflicting procedural demands, leading to conversational termination or escalation elsewhere.
codes.inclusion_rule: Apply to non-negotiable demands, refusal to discuss, repeated-demand recognition, or exit to appeal.
codes.exclusion_rule: Exclude firm preferences that still include a mutually workable option.

exemplars.quote: I am ending this conversation and using the platform appeal.

assignments.rationale: The buyer specifies the color mismatch and asks for replacement or refund.
The seller requests a label photograph, names a comparison record, and conditionally offers return coverage.
The buyer reports providing the requested photograph and narrows an acceptable resolution.
The buyer identifies how the earlier phrase was heard as dismissive.
The seller apologizes for wording, explains tracking, and offers inquiry or a three-day refund condition.
The buyer accepts the timeline conditionally on receiving an inquiry number.
The seller revises an accusation reading into recognition that the buyer listed missing parts.
The buyer clarifies intent, offers photographs, and proposes missing parts as an alternative remedy.
The seller accepts the proposal and commits to evidence-based confirmation before shipment.
The buyer demands an immediate full refund and refuses another video.

themes.name: Repair becomes actionable through recognition and bounded next steps
themes.claim: Across three dialogues, disputes move toward repair when speakers recognize the other's account and convert it into evidence-linked, conditional next steps.
themes.explanation: Evidence alone is not treated as sufficient: progress also includes an apology or reinterpretation, a specific remedy, timeline, or reciprocal acceptance. These are sequence-level observations rather than stable speaker traits.

evidence.quote: If we shipped the wrong color, I will cover the return.

themes.name: Procedural rigidity produces impasse
themes.claim: In the fourth dialogue, mutually incompatible demands over timing and renewed evidence are repeated rather than reformulated, and the buyer exits to an external appeal.
themes.explanation: The buyer refuses another video and requires an immediate refund; the seller refuses refund discussion without a new video. The next turn explicitly names repetition and terminates this channel.

evidence.quote: I will accept only a full refund today.
evidence.warrant: The buyer sets an exclusive remedy and immediate deadline.

evidence.quote: Our policy requires a new video with the serial number visible.
evidence.warrant: The seller sets an incompatible procedural prerequisite.

evidence.quote: Then we are repeating the same demand.
evidence.warrant: The buyer explicitly identifies non-progress before exiting.

counterevidence.quote: would accept the missing parts instead of a full refund
counterevidence.warrant: Another buyer broadens the acceptable remedy, enabling an agreement in that separate dialogue.

boundary_conditions: The impasse is observed in one three-turn dialogue and cannot establish either speaker's enduring behavior.
External platform appeal may later resolve the dispute, so impasse is limited to this conversation.

negative_cases.quote: I am ending this conversation and using the platform appeal.
negative_cases.implication: Unlike the three sequences showing movement toward agreement, this sequence terminates in-channel negotiation.

negative_cases.quote: I now see that you were listing the missing parts.
negative_cases.implication: An initially accusatory reading is revised, showing that perceived directness does not inevitably sustain conflict.

uncertainties: No dialogue confirms that a promised remedy was actually completed.

alternative_interpretations: Evidence requests can support verification or function as burdensome gatekeeping; sequence and uptake distinguish their role here.
The platform appeal may be a productive escalation rather than failed repair overall, though it marks impasse in this channel.
limitations: Each fictional dialogue contains only three turns.
The packet supports interactional process claims, not cultural or personality explanations.

output.research_question: What interactional processes move these fictional buyer-seller disputes toward repair or impasse?
output.analysis_summary: Across these fictional buyer-seller dialogues, repair is advanced when parties specify evidence, acknowledge how wording was received, offer bounded options, and translate positions into workable next steps. Impasse emerges where both parties hold fixed procedural demands and decline the other's requested proof or remedy, leading the buyer to exit to platform appeal.

themes.claim: In these excerpts, interpersonal acknowledgment of perceived dismissal or hostility helps move the conversation from defensiveness back to problem-solving.
themes.explanation: Where one party explains intent or apologizes for phrasing, the dialogue shifts from relational friction toward practical coordination.

evidence.quote: I am sorry my short wording sounded dismissive.
evidence.warrant: Direct acknowledgment of impact repairs the buyer's complaint about tone.

evidence.quote: Thank you for explaining the wording and giving a date.
evidence.warrant: The buyer's response shows that acknowledgment plus a timeline restored enough trust to continue.

evidence.quote: I now see that you were listing the missing parts.
evidence.warrant: The seller revises an earlier hostile reading of the buyer's message.

evidence.quote: I meant the numbered list to be clear, not hostile.
evidence.warrant: Clarifying intent supports a reset from accusation to evidence-sharing.

counterevidence.quote: I would like a replacement or a refund.
counterevidence.warrant: Some dialogues can begin with practical remedy talk without overt relational repair work.

counterevidence.quote: I will not discuss a refund without it.
counterevidence.warrant: Where no acknowledgment occurs, the conversation can remain procedural and harden into impasse.

boundary_conditions: This theme is about visible conversational resets, not inner states of politeness or empathy.
The packet does not show whether acknowledgment alone would suffice without a concrete procedural offer.

themes.name: Impasse emerges when both sides repeat non-negotiable positions and shift venue
themes.claim: In these excerpts, bilateral repair fails when one side insists on a single remedy and the other insists on a single proof requirement, producing repetition and external escalation.
themes.explanation: The fourth dialogue shows no jointly accepted next step. Instead, each turn reasserts a fixed condition, culminating in the buyer ending the exchange and using the platform appeal.

evidence.quote: I will accept only a full refund today.
evidence.warrant: The buyer states a non-negotiable outcome and rejects another video.

evidence.quote: Our policy requires a new video with the serial number visible.
evidence.warrant: The seller states a non-negotiable procedural demand.

evidence.quote: Then we are repeating the same demand.
evidence.warrant: The buyer explicitly names repetition as the interactional problem.

evidence.quote: I am ending this conversation and using the platform appeal.
evidence.warrant: Shows the shift from bilateral negotiation to third-party escalation.

counterevidence.quote: I can wait three more days if you send the inquiry number.
counterevidence.warrant: A conditional acceptance in another dialogue shows that firm concerns need not end in impasse if a shared path exists.

boundary_conditions: This theme is strongly supported by one dialogue sequence and should be read as a local pattern within the packet.
The appeal move indicates interactional impasse, not necessarily who is substantively correct.

negative_cases.quote: I can wait three more days if you send the inquiry number.
negative_cases.implication: Counters any claim that delay complaints automatically escalate; conditional trust can preserve the dialogue.

negative_cases.quote: would accept the missing parts instead of a full refund
negative_cases.implication: Shows that buyers do not always maintain maximal demands and may narrow the remedy to enable repair.

uncertainties: The packet does not show final outcomes after the shown turns, so repair is inferred from process rather than completion.
Some seller requirements may be platform-driven, but the packet does not justify treating policy as merely strategic obstruction.
The first dialogue implies likely resolution, but the final shipment or refund is not shown.
alternative_interpretations: KO_E10 could reflect buyer fatigue with repeated evidence requests rather than simple rigidity.
KO_E05 may be read as customer-service scripting, though it still functions interactionally as acknowledgment plus a plan.
KO_E07 and KO_E08 can be interpreted as mutual face repair as much as factual clarification.
limitations: Each dialogue is only three turns long, limiting observation of longer negotiation trajectories.
The packet is fictional and should support only bounded claims about the sequences shown.
No cultural or national traits should be inferred from wording, directness, or policy references.
